decision_rule: Ask for municipality or GPS before choosing EDL versus EDZ and before deciding if the issue is public grid or private.
examples: kahraba ray7a; no power in my area
notes: Zahle concession makes location mandatory for reliable auto-route.

decision_rule: If location is Zahle district or EDZ concession area use EDZ instead of EDL. Keep HITL when location is not exact.
examples: power outage in Zahle; transformer in Zahle; EDZ bill issue
notes: EDZ page says it operates and maintains distribution networks in Zahle and 15 surrounding regions under concession.

decision_rule: Do not route private generator faults to EDL or EDZ unless citizen also reports public grid fault.
examples: moteur l eshtirak kharben; generator owner overbilling; private generator noise
notes: Private generator disputes are outside EDL field responsibility. Regulatory or local handling varies.

decision_rule: Ask whether the problem is inside the building after the public meter or in the public grid.
examples: breaker tripping inside apartment; building panel burned; internal wire
notes: Internal wiring is not a public utility dispatch unless public network hazard is present.

decision_rule: Route local streetlight fixture outage to municipality. If pole wire box or supply side is sparking use utility plus CD.
examples: daw l shere3 ma 3am ydawe; streetlight out
notes: Existing entity boundary condition BC-001 encodes this split.

decision_rule: Call Civil Defense first if immediate public danger and route grid isolation to EDL or EDZ by location.
examples: shortan mkashfin; sando2 kahraba yshar2et; exposed live wire
notes: Do not treat as routine outage. Use exact location and keep HITL.

decision_rule: Civil Defense first for scene safety then EDL or EDZ for grid equipment isolation and repair.
examples: transformer on fire; substation smoke; explosion near power box

decision_rule: Route to EDL outside Zahle or EDZ in Zahle. MEW only for policy or unresolved escalation.
examples: electric meter broken; bill wrong; subscription number complaint
notes: EDZ form has account-specific required fields. EDL exact public intake fields remain not published in captured sources.

decision_rule: Use MEW only after operational entity is identified and ordinary field route is not enough.
examples: complaint about EDL non response; electricity-sector policy question
notes: MEW supervises sector but is not first-line outage repair.
